crossRefs.note: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out…
All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade…
You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper…
He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness…
There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…
and I will give him the morning star.
I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of…
that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city…
How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
“You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy…

translations.web: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
translations.bsb: How you have fallen from heaven, O day star, son of the dawn! You have been cut down to the ground, O destroyer of nations.
translations.kjv: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
translations.asv: How art thou fallen from heaven, O day-star, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, that didst lay low the nations!
